comments.body_html: Well, this looks pretty awesome. Do you plan on adding more quest objectives?

comments.author: shaneeexd
comments.body_html:
Yes I plan on adding features to allow for a lot more complex quests, just wanted to get out an early working version for people to utilise :)

I plan on adding things such as:

  • Weapon/Gear/Time of Day restrictions
  • Distance restrictions
  • “Kill X in one raid and Extract” type compatibility
  • Zones for placing quest items/kill enemy in zone/visit location

Edit: These restrictions will be combinable, for example “Kill 3 PMC’S using a Bolt-Action Rifle in X area”

These should be fairly easy for me to implement, the long part is testing every scenario for bugs.

I am also currently working on repeatable quests (the daily and weekly ones) but they have proven to be difficult to get to work correctly so no promises on that one.
